title: aspidium chrysotrichum
intro: Aspidium chrysotrichum, commonly known as the Golden Shield Fern, is a plant species in the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium chrysotrichum include antispasmodic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, skin irritations, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
